Record Class Names

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.clafer.frontend.Names
Record Components:
clafers - the clafers of the model, enumerations and their literals included, in declaration order
uses - the clafer each written name refers to, by the name's span
public record Names(List<Symbols.ClaferSymbol> clafers, Map<SourceSpan, Symbols.ClaferSymbol> uses) extends Record
What the names of a model refer to, for the language server: the clafers, whose Symbols.ClaferSymbol.nameSpan() is where each is declared, and the clafer that each written name refers to, by the span of the name.

The names are those of the constraints, assertions, objectives, initial values and reference targets, as the resolver resolves them, and those of the supers and the references to a clafer by name, as the symbols resolve them. In a path a.b or A\b, each name has its own span. The special names (this, parent, dref, ...), the primitive types and the locals of quantifiers and let are not in it. The spans are in the lines of the model, the files of its imports first (ModelFiles.position(int)).
